invalid_printer_name.title: Printer name should be reconfigured
invalid_printer_name.description: The configured printer name `{printer_name}` is not safe for MQTT topics. Change the identifier on the bridge, then remove and add the integration entry again. Use only lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.

outdated_bridge_version.title: Bridge software is outdated
outdated_bridge_version.description: The bridge for `{printer_name}` reports version `{bridge_version}`. Update the Raspberry Pi bridge to at least `{minimum_version}` so it matches the installed Home Assistant integration.

legacy_mqtt_discovery.title: Legacy MQTT printer entities remain
legacy_mqtt_discovery.description: {printer_name} still has MQTT Discovery entities from an older bridge. Update and restart the bridge so it clears the obsolete retained discovery configuration; then remove any orphaned MQTT device if Home Assistant still shows one.
